ask.title: Ask a question
ask.why: A clear question gets clear answers.
bullets: Fix questions that are not clear.
ask.doneWhen: you pick a question and fix both questions.

plan.title: Make a plan
plan.why: A prediction helps you spot surprises in the data.
bullets: Predict the answer before you look.

collect.title: Collect data
collect.why: Answers are your data. You need data to find out.
bullets: Ask our pretend class your question.
This class is made up, just for learning.

graph.title: Draw graphs
graph.why: Graphs help us SEE the answer.
bullets: Ask: what can it NOT tell us?
graph.doneWhen: you answer both questions and tap I'm done.

number.title: Find the statistics
number.why: Statistics say the answer in one number.
bullets: Find the mean, median, mode and range.
Each one tells a different story.
number.whyWords: The mode tells us the most popular answer.
bulletsWords: Find the game picked the most.
Find out why words need the mode.

chance.title: Test chance
chance.why: Chance helps us say how sure we can be.
chance.doneWhen: you test it and tap I'm done testing.

conclude.title: Show your evidence
conclude.why: Now you prove your answer with your evidence.
bullets: Say what you found, with proof.
